title: Villager vocation_tome
description: Vocation Tome lets you extract a villager’s profession and trades into a special book, then transfer that profession to another villager — turning a fleeting trade hall into a permanent, portable library of professions.
body:
# Summary

**Vocation Tome** lets you capture a villager’s entire trade knowledge in a single book, then imprint it onto any other villager. Manage dozens of professions through one villager, rescue irreplaceable trades, and build the ultimate portable library of professions.

---

# Description

Vocation Tome isn’t just a tool — it’s a completely new way to manage villagers. Instead of building endless rows of job-site blocks and minecart prisons, you reduce your entire trading empire to a handful of books.

## One Villager, Every Profession

Because the Tome fully overwrites a villager’s profession, level, and trades, you can cycle multiple professions through a single, easy-to-reach villager.  
- Want mending books? Apply the **Librarian tome**.  
- Need golden carrots? Swap to the **Farmer tome**.  

One trading hall, one villager, zero hassle. No more cramming twenty villagers into a noisy chamber.

## Trade Preservation & Transfer

Got a villager with a perfect, painstakingly unlocked trade? Store it in a Vocation Tome. The book saves everything — profession, level, experience, and every single trade with its exact pricing and usage limits.

Use it to:

- **Move** a valuable trade to a safer or more convenient location.
- **Duplicate** a perfect trade across multiple villagers (yes, one trapped source villager can arm an entire army of blank slates).
- **Create a backup.** If a creeper erases your master armorer, just apply the backup tome to a fresh unemployed villager.

## Inventory‑Friendly Design

- The item name changes dynamically — you’ll see `Vocation Tome (Librarian‑2)` at a glance, no NBT digging required.
- Hold **Shift** to browse every stored trade, complete with quantities and items.

## Sensible Restrictions & Feedback

- By default, the Tome refuses to overwrite a villager that already has a profession, preventing accidents. This can be toggled on for full freedom.
- Every blocked action explains itself in the action bar — no silent failures.
- In survival, extracting a profession consumes a regular **Book**. Applying a Tome returns a Book by default (configurable), keeping the loop clean.

## Perfect for Multiplayer and Advanced Play

- **Trade Tomes** with other players on a server. Your friend just bred a perfect Librarian? Ask for a copy.
- Set up adventure‑map shops or custom trading stations using command‑spawned Tomes.
- Temporarily “borrow” a profession from a wild villager to transport it to your base.

> Vocation Tome fits naturally into vanilla survival, adding no GUIs or complex machines — only a clever book and a deeper layer of villager strategy.
### Item Details

· The item name dynamically shows the stored profession and level (e.g. “Vocation Tome (Librarian‑2)”).

· Hold Shift in the inventory to see every trade stored in the book.

### Server‑only Logic

All interactions are handled entirely on the server, making the mod multiplayer‑safe and light on clients.

Vocation Tome is designed to feel like a natural, vanilla‑style utility — no GUIs, no machines, just a book that knows a villager’s craft.
